mapper.update: UPDATE ALIPAY_PAY_LOG SET PAY_STATUS = #{payStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRADE_NO = #{tradeNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRANS_TIME = #{transTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_AMOUNT = #{payAmount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RESULT_CODE = #{resultCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RESULT_MSG = #{resultMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

UPDATE ALIPAY_PAY_LOG SET PAY_STATUS = #{payStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRADE_NO = NVL(#{tradeNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRADE_NO), TRANS_TIME = NVL(#{transTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRANS_TIME), PAY_AMOUNT = NVL(#{payAmount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_AMOUNT), RESULT_CODE = #{resultCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RESULT_MSG = #{resultMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (PAY_STATUS IS NULL OR PAY_STATUS != 'SUCCESS')

UPDATE ALIPAY_PAY_LOG L SET REFUND_AMOUNT = TO_CHAR(( SELECT NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(R.REFUND_AMOUNT)), 0) FROM ALIPAY_REFUND_LOG R WHERE R.ORDER_NO = L.ORDER_NO AND R.REFUND_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' AND R.DELETE_FLAG = '0' )), REFUND_STATUS = CASE WHEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(R.REFUND_AMOUNT)), 0) FROM ALIPAY_REFUND_LOG R WHERE R.ORDER_NO = L.ORDER_NO AND R.REFUND_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' AND R.DELETE_FLAG = '0') <= 0 THEN L.REFUND_STATUS WHEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(R.REFUND_AMOUNT)), 0) FROM ALIPAY_REFUND_LOG R WHERE R.ORDER_NO = L.ORDER_NO AND R.REFUND_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' AND R.DELETE_FLAG = '0') >= NVL(TO_NUMBER(L.PAY_AMOUNT), 0) THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END WHERE L.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ALIPAY_PAY_LOG WHERE 1=1
AND THIRD_USER_ID = #{thirdUserId}
AND PAY_STATUS = 'SUCCESS'
AND PAY_STATUS != 'SUCCESS'
AND INVOICE = #{invoice}
AND TO_DATE(TRANS_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= TO_DATE(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TO_DATE(TRANS_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < TO_DATE(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1

SELECT ORDER_NO AS orderNo, PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, TRADE_NO AS tradeNo, TRADE_NO AS channelOrderNo, TRANS_TIME AS transTime FROM ALIPAY_PAY_LOG WHERE ENTRY_ID = #{entryId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
